reels.caption: POV: leg day but there's no floor
reels.fact: Astronauts exercise about 2 hours a day so their bones and muscles don't waste away.

reels.caption: me harvesting the hottest crop in the galaxy
reels.fact: In 2021 astronauts grew and ate the first chile peppers ever grown on the space station.

reels.caption: you are literally mostly water rn
reels.fact: About 71% of Earth's surface is covered by water.

reels.caption: when the group chat goes off at 3am
reels.fact: Centripetal force pulls a spinning object toward the center of its circle.

reels.caption: tomatoes under the pink party lights
reels.fact: Astronaut Frank Rubio spent 371 days in space, the longest single trip by an American.

reels.caption: holding the whole world like it owes me money
reels.fact: Momentum is mass times velocity: heavy and fast is hard to stop.

reels.caption: space food hits different (it hits less)
reels.fact: Food tastes blander in space because fluids drift to your head and stuff up your nose.

reels.caption: no bees? I'll do it myself
reels.fact: With no bees in space, astronauts pollinate pepper flowers by hand.

reels.caption: tiny helicopter, big dreams
reels.fact: Ingenuity was the first aircraft to make a powered, controlled flight on another planet, in 2021.

reels.caption: the floor is approaching (it's Mars)
reels.fact: Perseverance landed in Mars's Jezero Crater on February 18, 2021.

reels.caption: rover selfie, helicopter photobomb
reels.fact: The rover's famous selfie with Ingenuity was stitched together from 62 photos.

reels.caption: Jupiter's red spot has been a storm longer than your situationship
reels.fact: Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a storm wider than the whole Earth.

reels.caption: the sun when I open my blinds
reels.fact: This solar flare was filmed by NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory, which watches the Sun nonstop.

reels.caption: home is that little crescent
reels.fact: On Artemis I in 2022, the Orion capsule flew around the Moon with no crew on board.

reels.caption: four parachutes and a dream
reels.fact: Crew Dragon slows down under four main parachutes before splashing into the ocean.

reels.caption: me leaving the function early
reels.fact: Artemis I launched on NASA's SLS rocket on November 16, 2022.

reels.caption: gold visor = main character
reels.fact: Apollo 15 in 1971 was the first mission to drive a car on the Moon: the Lunar Roving Vehicle.

reels.caption: fishbowl helmet fit check
reels.fact: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on July 20, 1969.

reels.caption: just parked the jet, no big deal
reels.fact: The first American astronauts, the Mercury Seven, were all military test pilots.

reels.caption: desert survival training but make it a group photo
reels.fact: Early astronauts trained to survive in the desert in case their capsule landed off course.

reels.caption: the hallway in my apartment, but in space
reels.fact: The space station is about as long as a football field.

reels.caption: getting weighed with no gravity
reels.fact: Scales don't work in orbit, so a machine weighs astronauts by measuring how hard it is to push them.

reels.caption: which way is up? doesn't matter
reels.fact: On the space station there is no real 'up' or 'down'.

reels.caption: when the new crew finally shows up
reels.fact: People have lived on the space station nonstop since November 2000.
